# Choose UTF-8 conversion for text and byte-string streams for encoded payloads

The owned stream API port uses setUTF8Data for calendar upload/ICS/CardDAV text and setByteStringData for already encoded message, OpenPGP and XMPP photo data. Accepted call sites retain these choices and the CardDAV request method still follows upload setup. Follow the actual data representation, not the variable name string or one generic setter replacement. No non-ASCII/binary round-trip experiment was run. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: String stream text and byte representation.
